Present case has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C./528 B.N.S.S. with following main prayer:-
"WHEREFORE, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased set aside the cognizance order dated 08/02/2023 passed by ACJM III,
Lucknow, in case no. 36 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 119 of 2022 Under section 498A, 323, 313, 506, 120B IPC & 3/4 DP Act P.S. Sadat Ganj, District Lucknow, along with the charge sheet no. 01 of 2023 dated 17/12/2022, so far it Sumit Singh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. 1 relates to the applicant, contained collectively as Annexure no. 1;
And, to set aside the entire proceedings of Session Trial No. 2477 of 2024 "State Vs Amit Singh & others" arising out of Case Crime No. 119 of 2022 Under section 498A,
323, 313, 506, 120B IPC & 3/4 DP Act P.S. Sadat Ganj, District Lucknow and the order dated 07/03/2025 passed by trial court, whereby rejecting the discharge application filed by the applicant, contained as Annexure No. 2 with this application,
in the interest of justice, till it extends its benefit to the ambit of applicant."
Learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection regarding the maintainability of the present application as the applicants have a statutory alternative remedy to file a revision under Section 397 Cr.P.c./438 B.N.S.S.
